title: Bali Couples Escape with Night Safari
alt: Tegalalang rice terraces near Ubud, Bali
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Bedugul and the safari park
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small villa property on the quiet edge of Ubud

activities.name: Kintamani and rice terrace day tour
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the way to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot sunset
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan at Bedugul, then Tanah Lot on its rock shelf as the light goes.

activities.name: Bali Night Safari
activities.description: An evening tram ride through Bali Safari and Marine Park to see the night animals, with a fire dance performance and dinner at the park.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Four nights in a villa on the edge of town, with the crater lake at Kintamani, the lake temples of Bedugul and an evening safari.

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Nusa Penida
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Large pool hotel ten minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Nusa Penida west coast by speedboat
activities.description: A private island day: Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach, with a speedboat each way from Sanur.

activities.name: Balinese massage for two
activities.description: A traditional Balinese massage for both of you, warm oil and long pressure strokes, booked privately at a spa near your hotel.

activities.name: Sunset dinner cruise
activities.description: A half day cruise out of Benoa harbour with dinner on board and live music, timed for sunset over the Bukit peninsula.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Two nights on the coast with a private island day on Nusa Penida, a couples massage and a sunset cruise with dinner on the water.

day_titles.4: An evening at the night safari
day_titles.5: Nusa Penida and on to Kuta

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Ubud villa and settle in
First evening free among the rice fields
Optional: Goa Gajah, the art market or the ARMA museum
2: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
3: Breakfast, then north to the Handara gate for photographs
Ulun Danu Beratan, the temple standing on the lake
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
Evening back in Ubud at your own pace
4: Breakfast and a slow morning at the villa
Afternoon at Bali Safari and Marine Park
Night tram ride past the lions, tigers and rhinos
Fire dance performance and dinner at the park
5: Early breakfast and check out, then on to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach
Private transfer to your Kuta hotel in the evening
6: Breakfast and a slow morning by the pool
A traditional Balinese massage for two at a nearby spa
Sunset dinner cruise out of Benoa harbour
Optional: Kuta Square or the art market before the cruise
7: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Four nights in Ubud is the luxury here. You unpack once, and the island comes to you day by day.
expert.tip: The night safari runs late, so keep the next morning gentle. Couples usually ask for the cruise on the last full evening, and it is the better order because you fly home relaxed.

summary: Seven days for two with four nights in a villa near Ubud, the crater lake at Kintamani, lake temples at Bedugul, an evening safari with dinner, then Nusa Penida, a couples massage and a sunset dinner cruise from Kuta.
included: Included: 6 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; Kintamani and rice terrace tour; Bedugul and Tanah Lot sunset tour; Bali Night Safari with dinner; private Nusa Penida west coast tour; Balinese massage for two; sunset dinner cruise.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and other dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
